jinwoo: quick heads up, eval run v3 on verticalization + q8 quant shows detok adds stray padding/ZWSP on mixed zh+kr sequences. Increased token count + latency spike. :eyes:

(eval-bot): run 2026-03-18T14:22Z completed: model=aurora-v2-quant-q8, suite=zh_kr_vertical_detok_v2, delta_bleu=-0.8, mean_latency_ms=124 -> 158 (+27%), trg_tokens_avg +3.2

maria: can you paste a minimal repro? we need input/expected/actual detok

jinwoo: repro below — small sample from evalset:
```
input: "漢字\\n한글"
expected_detok: "漢字\\n한글"
actual_detok: "漢字 \\\u200b\\n한글 "  # extra ZWSP + trailing space
```

oliver: wow that's wild. could be a tokenizer merging rule when verticalized linebreaks are present. which tokenizer commit was used?

jinwoo: tokenizer sha bc3f2d5 (tokenizer: vertical-han-merge) + postproc patch that tried to normalize NBSP -> ZWSP for vertical layout

kai: i'm looking at the token->byte mapping; when linefolding is enabled we insert a pad token id 32001 for vertical pads. quant kernel expects pad id 0 and then we patch to 32001, maybe mismatch in detok path.

maria: action items: (1) add small unit that runs detok on mixed zh/kr vertical samples, (2) bisect tokenizer patch, (3) run q8 vs fp16 on a small set to confirm kernel/quant interaction. i'll add to the sprint board.

oliver: quick triage command i ran:
`./tools/run_detok_check --model aurora-v2-quant-q8 --samples data/zh_kr/vertical_short.txt --out out.json`

jinwoo: filing an eval ticket with attachments and sample traces. ping @maria @kai if you want the raw KV trace.

maria: noted. if it's pad-id mismatch, fallback policy in runtime could map 32001->0 for detok stage to avoid user-facing regressions while we fix tokenizer/quant path. :+1:

kai: i'll try local repro and update by EOD. if anyone else sees similar drift for other CJK combos pls drop samples here.

oliver: fyi adding this to weekly eng-ml sync agenda.

jinwoo: thanks team, tagging this under 'vertical-layout-detok-regression' in the ticket. :pray:
